summary_1line: Arjuna recounts Indra’s gifts and stay in heaven, then demonstrates celestial weapons, shaking the cosmos until sages warn him not to use them without cause.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands armored with Gandiva and the conch Devadatta as the earth trembles, mountains and trees shaking while celestial weapons blaze around him.
Gods, sages, Gandharvas, and Apsaras gather in the sky above Arjuna, showering flowers and music as he reveals the divine weapons.
Narada arrives amid the assembled gods and raises his hand to stop Arjuna from releasing the celestial weapons that threaten the worlds.
